read.thesis: Europe restarting all blast furnaces with Q3 shipments guided stable to higher and EBITDA of $98/t, a three-year high, supported by TRQ; Q2 EBITDA $2.1bn at $155/t.

utilisation.quote: that's why we have brought back the furnaces, so we have three furnaces running. We will be running, actually, all of our furnaces in Europe from quarter three onwards.
